_comment: Sports feed v2. Semantically identical to sports_game.json but the API vendor reordered the nesting: 'league' is now nested inside 'region' instead of 'region' being a field inside 'league'. This is the exact nesting-order shift the user described. A versioned adapter (V1/V2) could handle this, but JsonFlattener + SchemaResolver is better: one resolver rule maps both 'league_region' (v1) and 'region_name' (v2) to the canonical 'region_name', and both 'league_name' (v1) and 'region_league_name' (v2) to 'league_name'. No new adapter class needed.
